Hi Sarah — thanks for sending these slots and for the heads up on DST. Quick note on the DST situation: US clocks spring forward on Sun Mar 8 (PST -> PDT) which will shift Pacific conversions by +1 hour relative to your AEDT times. I want to avoid any confusion on the day-of, so I propose we lock a slot that is unambiguous for both sides.

The options you listed convert approximately to Pacific and GMT as follows (after US DST starts):
- Mon 9 Mar, 10:00 AEDT -> Mon 9 Mar 16:00 UTC / Mon 9 Mar 09:00 PDT
- Tue 10 Mar, 14:00 AEDT -> Tue 10 Mar 03:00 PDT / Tue 10 Mar 18:00 UTC

Those look a bit late for our US team. Would either of these alternative windows work for you and EMEA?
- Option A: Wed 11 Mar, 09:00 PT / Wed 11 Mar 16:00 UTC / Thu 12 Mar 03:00 AEDT
- Option B: Thu 12 Mar, 08:00 PT / Thu 12 Mar 15:00 UTC / Fri 13 Mar 02:00 AEDT

If one of those works I'll send a calendar invite (with an .ics) and include a short agenda. Jonas will join as the Solutions Engineer.

Best,
